ideas.pitch: An interactive execution trace visualizer specifically built for debugging complex data structure and algorithm problems against hidden test cases.
ideas.problem_statement: 2 Coding Problems based on Data Structures, Algorithms, and Problem Solving
ideas.title: AlgoTrace Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a direct pain point for candidates dealing with hidden test case failures during algorithmic assessments by offering precise step-by-step state visualization.

ideas.pitch: A targeted spaced-repetition and code-reasoning engine designed to prep candidates for domain-based and programming language MCQs.
ideas.problem_statement: 2 Domain-Based MCQs covering core Computer Science concepts and 5 Programming Language MCQs testing programming fundamentals
ideas.title: CS-Concept Flash & Quiz Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the MCQ portion of the technical assessment using active recall patterns and code snippets for language-specific traps.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight static analysis tool that estimates time and space complexity of code submissions before execution to prevent TLE (Time Limit Exceeded) errors.
ideas.problem_statement: Candidates are expected to consider both correctness and efficiency of their solutions against multiple test cases
ideas.title: ComplexityGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Helps solo candidates instantly spot inefficient nested loops and suboptimal data structure choices that cause hidden test case failures.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first test case generator that automatically produces edge cases, boundary values, and stress tests from a natural language problem description.
ideas.problem_statement: Coding questions will be evaluated against multiple test cases, including hidden test cases.
ideas.title: TestGenie Solo
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the critical need for robust self-testing when candidates have no interactive partner to review their edge cases.

ideas.pitch: A language-specific linter and AST-based playground focusing purely on tricky syntax, scoping rules, and pointer/reference semantics tested in language MCQs.
ideas.problem_statement: 5 Programming Language MCQs testing programming fundamentals, code reasoning, and language-specific concepts
ideas.title: SyntaxRuler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on code reasoning pitfalls like operator precedence, closures, and memory models that frequently appear in technical assessments.
